criteria.name: npm run verify passes
criteria.evidence: Ran `npm run verify` from repo root: 117 tests passed, 0 failed; `tsc --noEmit` clean; `vite build` produced dist/ artefacts successfully.

criteria.name: docs/INTERFACE.md unchanged
criteria.evidence: `git diff --stat 82dbfd0..HEAD -- docs/INTERFACE.md` returns empty; no modifications since the stage-cards baseline commit.

criteria.name: Mandelbrot and Julia paramSchema show palette default "inferno"
criteria.evidence: Neither kernel's paramSchema contains a palette key. src/sims/mandelbrot/kernel.ts:64-119 lists only centerX, centerY, zoom, maxIterations, palettePhase, cycleSpeed. src/sims/julia-set/kernel.ts:113-154 likewise has no palette key. Palette default is owned by the renderer in src/app/colormap.ts:138 (`mandelbrot -> preset: "inferno"`) and :140 (`julia-set -> preset: "inferno"`), not by paramSchema. The criterion as literally written cannot pass given how this codebase models palette defaults.

criteria.name: Cycle-speed default exactly doubled in both kernels
criteria.evidence: `git show 61c0139` shows DEFAULT_CYCLE_SPEED for mandelbrot 0.01 -> 0.02 (src/sims/mandelbrot/kernel.ts:31) and for julia-set 0.012 -> 0.024 (src/sims/julia-set/kernel.ts:33). Both are exact doublings of the pre-stage values.

criteria.name: Cycle-speed schema max >= 5 in both kernels
criteria.evidence: src/sims/mandelbrot/kernel.ts:116 has `max: 5`; src/sims/julia-set/kernel.ts:151 has `max: 5`. Both raised from the previous 0.08 in commit 61c0139.

criteria.name: Cleared localStorage -> Inferno on first load for /#/mandelbrot and /#/julia-set
criteria.evidence: src/app/colormap.ts:138 returns `preset: "inferno"` for mandelbrot (changed from "plasma" in commit b7c678c); src/app/colormap.ts:140 returns `preset: "inferno"` for julia-set (unchanged, was already inferno). defaultColourOptionsFor is the initial-render path; no localStorage gating present in that branch. Browser smoke-test not executed (verifier is headless), but code path is deterministic for the cleared-state case.

criteria.name: Per-slider override popover still persists to el:bounds:<slug>:cyclingSpeed
criteria.evidence: src/app/persistence.ts:3 retains `const BOUNDS_PREFIX = "el:bounds";` and :30-31 build the key as `${BOUNDS_PREFIX}:${slug}:${paramKey}`. cycleSpeed is still the schema key in both mandelbrot (kernel.ts:111) and julia-set (kernel.ts:147), so the override key resolves to `el:bounds:mandelbrot:cycleSpeed` / `el:bounds:julia-set:cycleSpeed`. Mechanism from commit 6259ee5 is untouched.

criteria.name: No files outside the deliverables set are modified (except the stage card)
criteria.evidence: Stage deliverables list: the three kernel.ts files and their .test.cjs siblings. `git show b7c678c` modifies src/app/colormap.ts:138, which is listed in the stage card as an *input* (line 26) but not a *deliverable* (lines 37-40). The orchestrator commit message explicitly flags this as a hot-patch made outside the deliverables set. (Other diffs in src/app/controls.ts, renderer.ts, simView.ts, styles.css come from unrelated commit 93db71b for a different stage and are not attributable to stage 02.)

additional_findings: Criteria 3 and 8 are in tension with each other given the codebase's architecture: the user-facing 'default palette = Inferno' goal is implementable only by editing src/app/colormap.ts (which is outside the deliverables set), because palette default is not modelled in paramSchema. The orchestrator hot-patch in commit b7c678c lands the user-visible behaviour but technically violates the literal acceptance criteria as written. Burning Ship was intentionally left out of the palette change (commit b7c678c message) but its cycle-speed default was doubled (0.008 -> 0.016) and max raised to 5 in commit 61c0139, consistent with the stage's 'if same controls exist, apply symmetrically' clause.
